cohort: Women with Hodgkin lymphoma (n=13) and healthy women (n=not specified)
finding: Ovarian tissue from women treated with ABVD chemotherapy for Hodgkin lymphoma contained a higher density of non-growing follicles and increased numbers of multiovular follicles but showed reduced in vitro growth compared to tissue from untreated lymphoma patients, patients treated with OEPA-COPDAC, and healthy women.
